subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between Q and S when counted from the right of Q. Only one person sits between S and N. Only one person sits between Q and R. Only two people sit between L and N. Only one person sits between O and R. Who sits third to the right of M?
solution:
L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only one person sits between Q and S when counted from the right of Q.
 
• Only one person sits between S and N. Only one person sits between Q and R.
 
• Only two people sit between L and N.
 
• Only one person sits between O and R.

The final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e20800871518e75c2e415e2a2e8a6787245095631b93478c1a15127a7f2815d.png] 

S sits third to the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
